objective: Build a source-auditable offline English encyclopedia from every pinned eligible FineWiki English shard
priority_rule: Descending August 2025 user pageviews summed across access types by page_id, then ascending page_id; unobserved views are unknown and sort last
lead_rule: Entire extracted lead before first level-2 heading; if no level-2 heading, whole text; always explicitly label lead tier
math_rule: Preserve extracted text bytes and wikitext math; never invent missing rendered formula
rights_rule: Retain original wikitext and text notices; quarantine recognized unresolved rights markers and missing source metadata; heuristic screening is not complete legal clearance
initial_storage: Per-article zlib blocks, SQLite contentless FTS5, on-disk metadata and aliases; no embeddings
checks: all source hashes and Parquet counts
acceptance: LLMRig staging only; Android, independent rights and rival/human acceptance remain open
evaluation_policy: Public builder development queries only; freeze before retrieval tuning, preserve baseline failures; no private holdout access
